meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
India mein ₹3000 ke budget mein kayi acche aur trusted running shoes available hain jo daily running, walking, aur gym workouts ke liye best hain.

The adidas Men Galaxy 7 Running Shoes features a **Cloudfoam midsole** for great cushioning and a **breathable upper** for daily road runs.

The Puma Men Skyrocket Lite 2 Running Shoes offers **PUMALITE cushioning** and **SOFTFOAM+ sockliners** to deliver a plush, lightweight feel.

The ASICS Jolt 4 Running Shoes For Men combines an **injection EVA midsole** and **OrthoLite sockliner** for durable, everyday comfort.

The Decathlon Kiprun Men Jogflow 190.1 Superior Grip Cushioned Running Shoes For Men is built for short-to-medium weekly runs with **exceptional grip** and **responsive cushioning**.

The Campus Mike N Running Shoes For Men provides a **budget-friendly option** featuring a **mesh upper** and EVA sole for stability.
